title: snack sync payload
description: The `data` of a `snack sync --json` document: one counted result per configured source. Counts only -- ingestion never reports what it read. Frozen at 0.9: a field here does not disappear or change meaning without a major release, and a consumer must tolerate fields added by a later minor.

path.description: Where the client keeps its own history, which the user told SNACK.

rejected_invalid.description: Records ingestion refused rather than guessed at.

failed.description: Whether this source failed; the run degrades rather than aborting the others.
